verdict.rationale: Stripe documents some data egress in open formats: financial report runs (balance, payouts, activity, tax, Revenue Recognition) produce downloadable CSV files, any API GET method can read account data, and a partner app syncs Stripe data into PostgreSQL. Nothing in the evidence covers a complete account export or an exit path, so 'export all of my data and leave' is only partly supported. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export, migration-out or offboarding path (e.g. customer/payment-method portability to another processor), coverage of non-financial objects in exports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
